text:
sarah: Heads-up: opened PR to consolidate onboarding playbook + fix auth example for containerized hello-world. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/987 Please quick glance before EOD? Highlights: use REDWOOD_API_KEY env var, add credential-helper note for local dev, and a Dockerfile multi-stage snippet.

mark: On it. quick scan — lgtm structurally but snippet-runner failing on py example :/ 

docs-bot: snippet-checker CI failed for PR #987

docs-bot: ```
Snippet runner output:
ERROR: snippet 3: import redwood
ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'redwood'
Exit code: 1
```

juan: Looks like the example assumes `redwood` is installed globally. Could we change the quickstart to include `pip install redwood-inference` or show a `requirements.txt` and `pip install -r requirements.txt`? Keep the snippet minimal.

megan: Also the python example still uses the old `import redwood` pattern. New SDK uses `from redwood import Client` (see SDK changelog). I'd swap to:

```
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
print(client.generate("hello"))
```

sarah: Good catches — pushing a fix. Updated PR with pip install + new import pattern + shortened snippet: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/987/files

mark: Re-running snippet-checker now. Also can we add a one-liner about token scope for Dedicated vs Hosted? Some customers hit confusing 403s when they use a restricted token in the wrong environment.

juan: Agree — add a gray callout: "Use a token with inference:generate scope for hosted API; use deployment-scoped tokens for Dedicated/Private". Short bullet, one sentence.

megan: I'll smoke test the container flow locally after Sarah pushes. Command I'll run:

```
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...
docker build -t rw-hello . && docker run -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=$REDWOOD_API_KEY rw-hello
```

megan: If that works I'll post a screenshot of the container output for the PR.

sarah: pushed again — added callout + updated Dockerfile multi-stage to `python:3.11-slim` base and pinned requirements. New commit: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/abc123

docs-bot: snippet-checker passed on the latest commit :party_parrot:

deploy-bot: Preview deployed: https://deploy-preview-987--redwood-docs.netlify.app/onboard/playbook

mark: Nice. I will approve once we add a short note on local credential helpers (where to put creds `.redwood/credentials` etc). We shouldn't document an internal tool but we can give the path and example env var.

sarah: Added a tiny paragraph about local credential helper + sample `~/.redwood/credentials` content. Thanks for the quick reviews everyone :thumbsup:

megan: Verified the docker run locally — logged output looks good. Screenshot uploaded to PR.

mark: Approving now. Will merge after 10:30am PT to let the preview propagate.

sarah: Thanks team — will follow up with a short migration note for the SDK change in the changelog page.

juan: I'll take care of the changelog blurb about `Client` import. 

megan: Thanks all. That should close several onboarding tickets. :tada:
